citation: Oliveira LM, Long AS, Brown T, Fox KR, Weber G. Melting temperature measurement and mesoscopic evaluation of single, double and triple DNA mismatches
what_it_anchors: 4096 measured 19-mer duplex Tm (all central-trimer mismatch contexts) at 50 mM NaCl + 10 mM Na-phosphate pH 7.4
claim: ESI Table S1 prints 4096 measured Tm for duplexes sharing the scaffold 5'-CGACGTGCN1N3N5ATGTGCTG-3'; classes are exactly 64 canonical / 576 single / 1728 double / 1728 triple. primer_tm() reproduces the RANKING (r 0.958, Spearman 0.941) but sits ~16.9 C low (sd 0.64) at the paper's own salt; the offset is not a Mg effect and is not corrected in the package
access_detail: fulltext.xml + ESI PDF SC-011-D0SC01700K-s001.pdf (pdftotext -layout); landed as inst/extdata/tm_mm2020_s1_measured.csv via data-raw/mm2020.R

citation: Establishment of a simple prediction method for DNA melting temperature: high-resolution melting curve analysis of PCR products
what_it_anchors: Measured vs predicted HRM amplicon Tm for the psaA-2 primer pair across 5 diatom species (Table 9), plus a 30-point Mg2+ series (S2 Table)
claim: Table 9 prints predicted/measured/difference for 5 species; every printed difference equals |predicted-measured| exactly. Amplicon-level (HRM), NOT oligo Tm, so it cannot test primer_tm() on a primer duplex; the Dia18S half is excluded because its primers are degenerate
access_detail: fulltext.xml (tables are HTML, text-extractable); S2 docx in supplements. Landed as inst/extdata/tm_hm2025_amplicon_psaa2.csv via data-raw/hm2025.R; Na+/K+/Mg2+/dNTP/DMSO not stated numerically in the paper
